description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pilikutthuwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, ownership transfers, and property rights - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
